source.attribution: Propane vapour pressure at 300 K: 9.974 bar, as cited in specs/models/eos/pure_saturation.yaml
source.notes: The same inherited attribution and the same caveat as the case below the saturation pressure: the boundary is external only as far as the published vapour pressure is. Paired with its opposite so that a flash which reported one phase unconditionally would fail one of the two - a single case would pass on a function that always answered the same way.

derivation: The companion to propane_below_its_saturation_pressure.json, at 11.0 bar - about 10% above the 9.9767 bar the kernels give and the 9.974 bar published. Above the saturation pressure the same single K-value falls below one, and the flash reports the liquid. The pair brackets the externally-validated boundary from both sides.
